races.name: Royal Jersey Laundry Clean Sweep Handicap

runners_data.name: Acclaimed Freedom
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has struggled on AW since soft ground debut win, needs to prove his Ascot form was genuine
runners_data.comment: Last of ten on his comeback ten days ago; something to prove in first-time cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: Some promise on 6f debut at Ascot (soft) and didn't need to come on a ton to win a 7f Chelmsford AW novice next time; has not looked ahead of his mark in two AW handicaps this year but perhaps he'll do better back at 6f on soft turf.

runners_data.name: Charlie Boyo
runners_data.note: Natural leader returning after 16-day break, likely to contest the early pace but may lack fitness edge for sustained battle
runners_data.comment: Good 2nd here on debut 12 months ago (5f); below par one month later; gelded; unexposed
runners_data.spotlight: Useful debut run at Salisbury (6f, good to firm) last May; turned over at a short price on only subsequent 2yo start but he made some late progress at Salisbury recently when returning from an  absence; on a fair mark on handicap debut if debut effort is taken at face value; now tongue tied.

runners_data.name: Campenaerts
runners_data.note: Former winner on soft who has disappointed for new connections, may need further weight relief to be competitive
runners_data.comment: Record of 2-3 in handicaps last term; below par on stable/seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Won two 5f events (including on soft) from final three handicaps for Archie Watson; well held in two runs for new yard and may need more weight off his back; first 6f run since debut.

runners_data.name: Cloudbuster
runners_data.note: Versatile in terms of distance and tactics, but disappointing last time when drawn widest at Lingfield
runners_data.comment: Mainly consistent last year, but has to overcome a 230-day absence and is drawn widest
runners_data.spotlight: Can lead; has form at both sprint trips but her win came in a 6f Chepstow maiden (good); had the widest draw to overcome when finishing last of nine on Lingfield AW in May and has more going for her in this lower grade back at 6f; first-time cheekpieces fitted.

runners_data.name: From The Hip
runners_data.note: Showed promise winning on Polytrack, entitled to improve significantly after comeback run on soft ground 18 days ago
runners_data.comment: 2yo campaign concluded with two wins; possible player if fully tuned up for comeback
runners_data.spotlight: Well positioned when winning final two juvenile starts at 6f on Polytrack; entitled to need the run on his recent comeback at Haydock (6f, soft) and open to some improvement regardless of what the weather does.

runners_data.name: Got The Booty
runners_data.note: Front-runner who has been competitive in recent AW runs, likely to press for early lead but stamina questioned
runners_data.comment: Solid fourth at Southwell last month, leading long way; not out of things reverted in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Two narrow 6f defeats on the AW either side of a winter break, the latest at Southwell against a subsequent winner, but she didn't do as well there next time and the return to turf didn't pay dividends at Catterick since; goes into handicap company with a bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Woolisle
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with a soft ground win last season, well-placed after creditable return 18 days ago
runners_data.comment: In good form in soft/heavy-ground nurseries last October; conditions to suit on return
runners_data.spotlight: Best 2yo form in the fifth of five handicap starts, when a ready winner over 5f at Nottingham (soft) last October and emerged with credit from her return, coming clear with an improved rival at Haydock (6f, soft; first two well clear) recently; up 2lb but one to fear if conditions deteriorate.

runners_data.name: Flying Squad
runners_data.note: Complete unknown over 6f having failed to stay longer trips, could surprise if pace collapses but hard to assess
runners_data.spotlight: Unable to sustain effort upped to 1m on Kempton AW in April and was always well adrift on final qualifying run there when back over 7f; unknown quantity over 6f with questions about how the ground wil be riding but, as a newcomer to handicaps for a leading yard, he has to be respected.

runners_data.name: Oceti
runners_data.note: Confirmed leader who tends to fade in finish, dangerous early but vulnerability late makes him hard to trust
runners_data.spotlight: All three runs on good ground; had four subsequent winners ahead of him when a front-running eighth of 25 at Newbury (1m) on reappearance but he didn't run to the same level back over 7f there next time and it's hard to know what to expect on the drop in trip on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Grey Horizon
runners_data.note: Hardy performer fresh off a Brighton win 10 days ago, drawn to track the pace and stay on strongly
runners_data.comment: Back in form at 6f when third of 14 on Saturday; same mark (due up 2lb) and strong claims
runners_data.spotlight: Hardy customer who has already run 23 times and was gaining his sixth win when successful at Brighton (6f, good to firm; has won on soft) ten days ago; back up 5lb but not weighted out of it; hereabouts.

runners_data.name: Exhibitioning
runners_data.note: Two-year-old returning after 234-day absence, best form was at this C&D in novice company last August
runners_data.spotlight: Best form on the second of four starts, when runner-up in a C&D novice last August; beaten a long way on her handicap debut at Haydock in October, when the 7f trip and/or the good to soft ground might have counted against her; off since and some guesswork needed.

runners_data.name: Unionville
runners_data.note: Has shown AW ability for this yard, returning after 61-day break with mixed form signals but some promise
runners_data.comment: Close second over C&D on stable/handicap debut and has dead-heated in a maiden since
runners_data.spotlight: Some turf promise in Ireland; has done better on AW for this yard, finishing a close second at Kempton on handicap debut, then dead-heating for a Chelmsford maiden (also 6f); never involved at Kempton in April but capable of better down in grade.

races.paceDynamic: Oceti, Charlie Boyo and Got The Booty will ensure a strong gallop from the start, with 5 more wanting prominent positions creating traffic problems approaching the final 2f. The sustained pace on soft ground will test stamina reserves over this 6f trip, particularly hurting any horse that gets into a battle for the early lead. The combination of genuine pace pressure and testing conditions clearly favours hold-up horses and those with proven stamina who can finish strongly when others tire.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and multiple prominent horses get involved in pace battles
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop on soft ground will cause a dramatic late fade from the pace-setters, allowing closers with stamina to sweep past tired leaders. Hold-up horses like Woolisle and Flying Squad benefit most from this classic scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders gets an easier time by establishing a clear advantage while the others duel
scenarios.body: Charlie Boyo or Got The Booty could steal a march if they avoid the early battle, maintaining just enough advantage to hold off late closers on testing ground. The winner needs both early tactical speed and stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Grinder Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but sustainable, favouring horses that can track the leaders without getting involved in early battles
scenarios.body: A horse like Grey Horizon or From The Hip positions perfectly behind the early pace, stays out of trouble, and has enough left to grind past tiring leaders in the final furlong. This suits battle-hardened performers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent brigade gets tangled up in traffic problems 2f out, creating gaps for an unconsidered runner
scenarios.body: The pace congestion causes interference and checking, allowing a horse like Exhibitioning or Flying Squad to find a clean passage and capitalize on the chaos ahead. Jockey skill becomes crucial in navigating the traffic.

watchPoints.text: Oceti's front-running style and fading tendency could see him set the pace then stop dramatically in the final furlong
Traffic problems are inevitable with Charlie Boyo, Got The Booty, Campenaerts, Cloudbuster and From The Hip all wanting prominent positions
Grey Horizon is the only runner with a recent win and could benefit from race fitness advantage over returning horses
Flying Squad is a complete 6f unknown after failing over longer trips, making him unpredictable in pace calculations
Woolisle's 5lb claimer Mason Paetel could be crucial in keeping her out of early pace battles from a hold-up position

races.name: O'Malley EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Phillipa
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; Dark Angel half-sister to 1m AW 2yo winner Beckon (RPR 67); dam once-raced sister to smart/prolific 6f-1m2f winner Muntadab, closely related to Coventry Stakes winner Nando Parrado, out of useful Argentinian 6f-1m winner; stable's 2yos yet to place this term but this one needs a second look.

runners_data.name: Roxelina
runners_data.spotlight: 170,000gns foal by Havana Grey; sister to 5f-1m winner Holguin (including 2yo/Listed; RPR 113), half-sister to 5f/6f winner Captain's Bar (including 2yo; 79); dam 1m AW winner (71); 6-5 for a C&D novice five weeks ago but got on edge and reared over at the stalls, so was withdrawn; hopefully keeps her cool this time and clearly very much one to note.

runners_data.name: Spirit Of Glory
runners_data.spotlight: Sixth foal; Cotai Glory half-sister to winners Starlight Time (7f/1m 2yo; RPR 86) and Be Glorious (6f AW 2yo; 73); dam 1m winner (including Listed; 105), half-sister to UAE 1,000 Guineas winner Lovely Pass, out of 1m Group 2 winner; from powerful yard and strength in the betting must be monitored.

runners_data.name: Starburster
runners_data.spotlight: 30,000euros foal, £125,000 yearling by Starman; first foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Electric Waves (5f 2yo Group 3), Appealing (useful 6f-1m) and Tut (7f 2yo), out of 1m-winning half-sister to Italian 1,000 Guineas third Baranja; connections run another six-figure purchase in Motown Filly.

runners_data.name: Courage Best
runners_data.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; seventh foal; Supremacy half-sister to winners Punita Arora (5f 2yo/5.5f Listed; RPR 99), Marching Mac (5f-6f; 90) and Sangria (1m AW; 77); dam 1m winner (75), half-sister to 7f Group 3 winner Muthabara and Group-placed 7f winner Mustadeem; trainer (runs two) had 2yo win in April.

runners_data.name: Desert Symphony
runners_data.spotlight: 72,000euros yearling by Ghaiyyath; tenth foal; closely related to 6f 2yo winner Bay Of Plenty (RPR 97), half-sister to five winners including Glesga Gal (7f AW; 100) and Vivianite (1m; 99); dam Listed-placed 6f 2yo winner (98); her trainer's first 2yo runner of the season.

runners_data.name: Glorious Game
runners_data.spotlight: £85,000 yearling by Pinatubo; eighth foal; closely related to winners Feliciana De Vega (7f-1m1f including 2yo/AW/Group 3; RPR 111) and Order Of Malta (1m2f; 82), half-sister to three winners including Matsuri (1m AW 2yo/1m2f turf; 117); dam 1m-9.4f winner (including Listed; 111); tongue tied for this debut; one to note for trainer whose 2yos are making a splash.

runners_data.name: Leading Raya
runners_data.spotlight: By Nando Parrado; second foal; dam Swedish 1m winner, half-sister to winners Miss Marble (useful 1m) and Master Diver (7f), out of Group-placed 6f AW winning half-sister to Group-placed 6f 2yo winner Rockaway Valley; others are a bit more striking on paper.

runners_data.name: Lola De Valence
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; Havana Grey half-sister to 7f winner Back In Black (including 2yo; RPR 101); dam 7f 2yo winner (78), half-sister to 1m Listed winner Awesometank, out of 6f 2yo winner; trainer also runs Courage Best.

runners_data.name: Motown Filly
runners_data.spotlight: 100,000gns yearling by Cotai Glory; ninth foal; half-sister to six winners including The Mackem Bullet (6f-1m including 2yo/US Grade 2; RPR 111), She's So Nice (6f including 2yo/US; 91) and Kick On Girl (1m 2yo; 81); dam 6f 2yo winner (80), half-sister to 2,000 Guineas third Stubbs Art; no 2yo win yet this term for the yard (runs two in this) but she needs a market check.

runners_data.name: Perfect Hope
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth foal; Perfect Power half-sister to French/UAE 5.5f-7f winner Itsatenfromlen (including 2yo/dirt; RPR 92); dam runner-up 8.6f AW 2yo (78), half-sister to 7f 2yo Group 3 winner Kilmah, out of 1m Listed winner; early days for the stable's 2yos.

runners_data.name: Bymiddaytomorrow
runners_data.spotlight: 90,000gns yearling by Mehmas; sister to 6f/7f 2yo scorer The Waco Kid (including Group 3; RPR 106); late foal; she's the only one in this field with racing experience, albeit not setting the world alight with her last of six in C&D novice (good to firm; 20-1) five weeks ago.

races.name: Hunter Plant Hire/MC International Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)

runners_data.name: Heir Of Ambition
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with 54 days off and history of fading in the finish, facing unsuitable tactical setup
runners_data.comment: Gelded; first foal out of a 5f AW winner (RPR 79); market should be informative on debut
runners_data.spotlight: 66-1, slowly away and checked at the start when tailed off in a novice at Southwell (1m, AW) in April.

runners_data.name: Screen Actor
runners_data.note: Unraced $100,000 yearling from strong trainer but complete unknown quantity making debut
runners_data.comment: The market can guide for this unraced son of Twirling Candy
runners_data.spotlight: $100,000 yearling, 40,000gns breeze-up 2yo by Twirling Candy; fourth foal; dam US Graded stakes-placed 1m/8.5f turf/dirt winner, half-sister to UAE 1m Group 2 winner Barbecue Eddie; probably best watched on debut; refused to enter stalls and withdrawn from last month's intended debut (28-1 at the time).

runners_data.name: Sonbelievable
runners_data.note: Debut runner with no form guide, related to decent winners but trainer struggling at 0/3
runners_data.spotlight: 9,000gns foal, £28,000 yearling; sixth foal; Mayson half-brother to winners Validated (GB 7f/HK 1m; RPR 99) and Credible (6f 2yo; 79); dam 6f AW 2yo winner (74), half-sister to winners Infallible (7f Group 3, dam of 1m Group 1 winner Veracious) and Remarkable (6f Listed); probably best watched on debut.

runners_data.name: Love Me Bae
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with 186 days off, previously tailed off but gets significant weight allowance as 2-year-old
runners_data.spotlight: 150-1, tailed-off last of nine in novice at Chelmsford (1m, AW) in December when trained by Alice Haynes.

runners_data.name: Bayaann
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with best form credentials, Tom Marquand booking and strong recent run suggest readiness
runners_data.spotlight: 410,000gns yearling by Too Darn Hot; made a smooth start with 7f maiden win on Lingfield AW in November and built substantially on that when second in a novice at Newmarket (1m, good) last month; that sets a high standard.

runners_data.name: Storming Point
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in good current form, placed on similar soft ground previously at Newbury
runners_data.comment: Runner-up at about 6f (soft) at Newbury in sole 2yo start and that form reads well
runners_data.spotlight: Dam was Group and Listed-placed at up to 1m1f in France; fair form when placed at Newbury (extended 6f, soft) in October and Kempton (7f, AW) 12 days ago; could still do better and has a strong place chance.

runners_data.name: Lean d'Aislingean
runners_data.note: Unproven type who fades in finish, made most last time but beaten 9 lengths suggests limited ability
runners_data.comment: 85,000euros yearling; by Ghaiyyath; one of a few newcomers in the field
runners_data.spotlight: 14-1, made most when well-beaten ninth of 11 in a novice at Nottingham (1m, good to soft) three weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Eljowhary
runners_data.note: Prominent racer from strong Varian stable, two recent runs show consistency around this level
runners_data.comment: Sixth of ten on his Newcastle debut this month; open to improvement
runners_data.spotlight: 140,000gns yearling; mid-division last month on AW at Newcastle (7f) and Southwell (1m), which showed significant ability but two of today's rivals have better form; a hood goes on.

runners_data.name: Florizelle
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner who improved on good to soft ground last time, gets 5lb allowance
runners_data.comment: Rank outsider and achieved little in 7f AW event
runners_data.spotlight: Improved when 9l sixth of 11 in novice at Nottingham (1m, good to soft; 300-1) three weeks ago but that's still modest form.

runners_data.name: Minerality
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who fades in finish, just 7 days since last poor effort at Wolverhampton
runners_data.comment: Well bred but 15l eighth on Lingfield debut (50-1) so a lot of improvement needed
runners_data.spotlight: Well related but showed low-level form over 1m on AW at Lingfield (50-1) and Wolverhampton (125-1) recently.

runners_data.name: Paean Of Appin
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with poor recent form, 52 days off and no signs of improvement
runners_data.comment: Always behind here (6f, good to soft; 25-1) in September, ducking left from inside stall
runners_data.spotlight: Finished last in Newbury maidens over 6f (good to soft; 25-1) in September and 1m2f (good; 125-1) in April; should do better in due course but has no claims at the moment.

races.paceDynamic: Florizelle will dictate from the front with minimal early pressure, as most rivals are hold-up performers or prominent racers who won't challenge early. Bayaann and Storming Point are the only likely early protagonists to track the leader, but both have proven they can settle. This creates a measured gallop over the first 6 furlongs before the pace lifts approaching the final 2 furlongs. The uncontested lead and soft ground conditions strongly favour front-running and prominent racing tactics, while hold-up horses face the double burden of making up ground on testing turf and potentially getting outpaced when the tempo increases.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Florizelle maintains her lead unchallenged through halfway
scenarios.body: The soft ground amplifies her advantage as hold-up horses struggle to close on the testing surface, while her sustained gallop becomes hard to peg back. Front-runners and prominent racers benefit most from the lack of early pressure and demanding conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Bayaann or Storming Point track Florizelle closely and time their challenge perfectly
scenarios.body: The class edge of these better-credentialed runners tells in the final furlong, but they need the leader to weaken sufficiently. Quality prominent racers with tactical speed benefit from being positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and the ground rides better than expected
scenarios.body: Late runners get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks, though they need significant pace collapse. Hold-up performers with proven stamina benefit from a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Florizelle stops quickly and prominent trackers fail to capitalize immediately
scenarios.body: The race becomes a scramble where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalize on the leaders' demise. Mid-field runners with tactical pace benefit from the chaos.

watchPoints.text: Florizelle must be monitored for early speed - if she doesn't go forward immediately, the entire pace scenario collapses
Bayaann's early positioning will be crucial - staying close enough to strike but not getting into an early battle
Screen Actor and Sonbelievable are complete unknowns who could possess unexpected ability on debut
The ground conditions may be softer than advertised given multiple Good to Soft readings across the card
Love Me Bae's return from 186 days off with new connections could spring a surprise at huge odds

races.name: Hunter Plant Hire/MC International Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)

runners_data.name: Baareq
runners_data.spotlight: 160,000gns yearling by Bated Breath; third foal; dam 1m2f winner (RPR 81), half-sister to winners Viadera (US 1m Grade 1), Sacred Bridge (6f 2yo Group 3) and Cross Baton (1m2f Listed); gelded newcomer (carrying notable colours) aged four who needs a market check.

runners_data.name: El Presidente
runners_data.spotlight: Ninth foal; Havana Grey half-brother to winners Durdle Door (6f/7f AW; RPR 85), Zoukster (6f/7f; 74) and Princess Salamah (8.6f AW 2yo; 72); dam 6f winner (97), half-sister to 8.5f 2yo Grade 1 winner Square Eddie; market should guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Next Guilian
runners_data.spotlight: By Guiliani; eighth foal; half-brother to six winners including Next Mine (1m 2yo/Italian Group 2; RPR 115) and Not Mine (Listed-placed 9.5f; 110); dam German 1m/1m1f winner (94), half-sister to German Derby winner Next Desert; 16-1, about 8l third of nine in maiden at Cologne (1m1f, soft) last November, hooded for new connections but he clearly possesses significant ability.

runners_data.name: Renovator
runners_data.comment: Already gelded and probably best watched unless the market suggests otherwise
runners_data.spotlight: 125-1, no show when last of 12 in maiden at Southwell (1m, AW) 18 days ago, a long way behind Kahin.

runners_data.name: Champagne Beau
runners_data.spotlight: By Frontiersman; second foal; dam 1m2f turf/1m3f AW winner (RPR 64), out of 1m3f-1m4f winning half-sister to useful 6f winners Kellys Eye and El Manati; late foal; sire and dam seem to point to longer trips.

runners_data.name: Cockade
runners_data.spotlight: Late foal, by Pinatubo from a notable family with stamina; second favourite when fourth of ten in a hot novice at Kempton (1m, AW) in December, making most; should improve and have a good shout in this race.

runners_data.name: Kahin
runners_data.comment: Looked in need of the experience on his Windsor debut; open to improvement
runners_data.spotlight: 240,000gns foal by Kingman; too green over C&D (good to firm) on debut early last month but he has scope and did much better when a close fourth of 12 as favourite in maiden at Southwell (1m, AW) 17 days later, always prominent; could still do with calming down a bit and also hung left in the closing stages last time, but he's a major contender again.

runners_data.name: Peace And Quiet
runners_data.comment: Makes belated debut aged four; by New Approach; check the market signals
runners_data.spotlight: Well related but not seen until three weeks ago when 200-1 and beaten about 10l in seventh of 11 for novice at Nottingham (1m, good to soft); should build on that but it was modest form.

runners_data.name: Star Baby
runners_data.spotlight: 8l sixth of 12 in maiden at Kempton (1m, AW) in April but she was second favourite and made some late headway; should do better but some others have accomplished much more.

runners_data.name: Atlas Mountain
runners_data.comment: Still open to improvement, albeit his ideal scene may be handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Three starts, best effort when a close and closing third of 11 from off the pace in novice at Nottingham (1m, good to soft; 20-1) three weeks ago; retains potential and should be placed at the least.

runners_data.name: Sound Gloria
runners_data.comment: Beat one home on her debut over C&D in November (16-1); needs a transformation
runners_data.spotlight: Ran twice at Southwell (1m, AW) and finished closer last time but was nevertheless beaten 14l at 50-1; late foal who looks bred for much further.

races.name: Install Electrical Contractors Limited Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBplus Race)

runners_data.name: Phantom Recon
runners_data.note: Lightly raced newcomer from powerful Scott stable with expensive yearling purchase suggesting significant ability for hold-up tactics
runners_data.comment: Nicely bred, but already gelded and may need a bit more time
runners_data.spotlight: 340,000euros yearling by Teofilo; closely related to Group-placed French/German 10.5f-12.2f winner Tres Rock Women (including AW; RPR 110), half-brother to French 1m4f winner Tiger Rock; dam 1m4f winner (including Listed; 98), sister to Listed-placed 1m2f/1m3f winner; withdrawn with an abscess at Newbury (1m2f) over three weeks ago; yard runs two; needs a close look.

runners_data.name: Asterial
runners_data.note: Even more expensive yearling than stablemate Phantom Recon with Sea The Stars pedigree indicating stamina and class for patient rides
runners_data.spotlight: 750,000gns yearling by Sea The Stars; second foal; dam 1m2f winner (RPR 89), closely related to 6f Listed winner Naadirr, half-sister to winners including Dubai Mile (1m2f 2yo Group 1); for powerful owners and for stable which runs two, the market can guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Indhaar
runners_data.note: Haggas newcomer by Ghaiyyath with excellent recent stable form suggesting readiness for debut from off the pace
runners_data.spotlight: By Ghaiyyath; closely related to 6f turf 2yo/7f AW winner Red Sand (RPR 89), half-brother to three winners including Red Mist (Listed-placed 7f/1m including 2yo; 107); dam Listed-placed 7f/1m winner (103) from family of top middle-distance filly Islington; withdrawn lame at Newbury (1m2f) over three weeks ago; one to note and the market should give useful clues.

runners_data.name: Steamroller
runners_data.note: Showed ability when sixth on debut despite racing freely, suggesting better with more patient tactics today
runners_data.comment: Attractive pedigree, but already gelded; this looks a warm race in which to make his debut
runners_data.spotlight: 200,000euros yearling by Too Darn Hot; well bred, including as half-brother to Queen Of The Pride (1m2f-1m4f winner; RPR 115); 50-1, raced freely early on when 6l sixth of nine in maiden at Newbury (1m2f, good) last month, never dangerous but showing promise; could be interesting.

runners_data.name: Virtue Diligence
runners_data.note: Long absence since poor September debut makes improvement unlikely despite hold-up style
runners_data.spotlight: 125-1, slow-starting ninth of 11 in novice at Kempton (1m, AW) in September, so has major work to do.

runners_data.name: Zachary Hickes
runners_data.note: Showed late ability when fourth on Kempton AW debut after 551 days off, suits patient ride
runners_data.spotlight: 105,000gns yearling; 25-1 for novice at Kempton (1m, AW) in December 2024 but showed plenty of ability staying on well from towards rear into fourth of 13; big player judged on that, but with the cautionary note that he's not been seen since; gelded last September; needs a market check.

runners_data.name: Cuff It
runners_data.note: Encouraging debut fifth from rear at Newmarket indicates clear improvement possible with hold-up tactics
runners_data.spotlight: £55,000 yearling by City Light; 22-1 when 8l fifth of ten in novice at Newmarket (1m, good) last month, coming from the back for an encouraging debut; the runner-up was Bayaann who is declared for today's 6.09; it looks as if 1m2f will help and he's one of the top contenders on form.

runners_data.name: Cyrano De Bergerac
runners_data.note: Solid second on debut for Gosden team suggests prominent racing ability and further improvement likely
runners_data.comment: By the stable's star miler Palace Pier and this colt cost 150,000gns as a yearling
runners_data.spotlight: 150,000gns yearling by Palace Pier; second foal; dam well-related 1m4f AW winner (RPR 78); 7-4 when chasing home an impressive 1-2 favourite in eight-runner maiden at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) six weeks ago, outpaced before grabbing second on the line; it wasn't great form behind him but he looks sure to improve and should go well in this race.

runners_data.name: Zurna
runners_data.note: Fading ninth three weeks ago on similar going shows lack of finishing speed despite hold-up style
runners_data.comment: 23,000gns 3yo; stable not associated with successful newcomers
runners_data.spotlight: Well related but 200-1 when weakening into ninth of ten for a novice at Nottingham (1m2f, good to soft) three weeks ago.

runners_data.name: Avarona
runners_data.note: Long 226-day absence since disappointing seventh makes fitness a major question mark today
runners_data.spotlight: 10-1, slowly away and only brief headway when 7l seventh of eight in a fillies' novice at Newbury (1m, soft) last October which was dominated by two stablemates; capable of better but looks bred for further still.

runners_data.name: Zynak
runners_data.note: Faded badly into last behind Steamroller last month indicating insufficient class for this level
runners_data.comment: Enough to like on breeding, but already gelded and would need to be above-average
runners_data.spotlight: 100,000euros yearling by Zarak; late foal; 66-1, never dangerous when fading into last of nine at Newbury (1m2f, good) last month, 6l behind Steamroller.

runners_data.name: All Of My Heart
runners_data.note: Jumps background with 187-day gap makes Flat debut highly speculative despite hold-up preference
runners_data.spotlight: 100-1, pulled hard and made most when behind in a bumper at Ludlow (2m, good to soft) in December.

runners_data.name: Eshowe
runners_data.note: Tailed off last on AW debut in December makes transformation needed despite losing hood today
runners_data.spotlight: 80-1 and hooded when last of 12 in maiden at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) in December, always behind; no hood today but he needs a transformation.

runners_data.name: Strong Man Tom
runners_data.note: Lowly rated with terrible recent form makes competitive effort virtually impossible
runners_data.comment: Struggled in both bumpers and in C&D maiden on recent Flat debut
runners_data.spotlight: Remote in two bumpers and beaten about 37l in two 1m2f Chepstow maidens.

runners_data.name: Sevenkingsmustdie
runners_data.note: Failed to settle in bumpers despite expensive purchase, Flat switch with hood remains highly speculative
runners_data.comment: Well behind stablemate Aribidia when sixth at Warwick and needs a big leap forward
runners_data.spotlight: Originally cost 425,000gns as a yearling; failed to settle when well beaten in bumpers at Warwick (hooded) and Haydock (tailed off) this spring; now switches to Flat rules with the hood restored.

runners_data.name: Prophet Squeeze
runners_data.note: Veteran jumper who tailed off on recent Flat debut indicates no chance of competitive performance
runners_data.comment: A lowly rated maiden over jumps; makes stable/Flat debut after 275-day absence
runners_data.spotlight: A lowly rated maiden over jumps who tailed off on Flat debut at Chepstow (1m2f) ten days ago; hooded on last eight starts.

races.paceDynamic: No confirmed front runners in this 16-runner novice field means early pace will likely be sedate, with most horses gravitating towards midfield positions. Steamroller and potentially Cyrano De Bergerac may be closest to the lead early, but neither has shown natural pace-forcing tendencies. The combination of soft going and lack of natural pace-setters will create a tactical affair that builds gradually before exploding into a sprint finish from the 2f pole. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with a finishing kick who can deliver late speed when it matters most.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate to slow as expected with no horse wanting the lead
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of finishing speed from 2f out, favouring horses with demonstrated late acceleration. Hold-up performers with proven finishing kicks thrive when given time to wind up their runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Steady Tempo Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Steamroller or Cyrano De Bergerac sets an honest but not strong pace from the front
scenarios.body: The race unfolds as a genuine stamina test over the trip, suiting horses who can travel kindly and sustain their effort. Prominent racers who can quicken off a solid gallop gain the advantage over pure sprinters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses converge on the rail turning for home causing interference or bunching
scenarios.body: The race becomes about finding clear room and getting a clean run rather than pure ability. Horses drawn wide or those getting first run have crucial advantages in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders go too slow and the field becomes bunched with 3f to run
scenarios.body: A mad dash develops from the furlong pole with pure speed trumping stamina or tactical positioning. Horses with natural acceleration from any position can capitalise on the chaotic finish.

watchPoints.text: Strong Man Tom and Prophet Squeeze lack any competitive form and could cause interference if struggling early
Steamroller and Sevenkingsmustdie have shown free-running tendencies that could disrupt the expected steady early pace
Phantom Recon and Asterial are expensive newcomers from Scott's in-form stable who could show significant improvement from debut
The large field size creates potential traffic problems turning for home, particularly affecting rails-drawn runners
Cyrano De Bergerac showed clear ability on debut and represents the Gosden stable in excellent current form

races.name: Fitzdares Sprint Series Handicap (Windsor Sprint Series Qualifier)

runners_data.name: Gaeli
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from Italy with heavy ground form but faces tactical disadvantage over short trip
runners_data.comment: Ex-Italian; won on stable debut at Southwell but he was down the field there last time
runners_data.spotlight: Five sprint wins on turf in Italy on ground ranging from good to heavy; smart AW form when winning on stable debut at Southwell (5f) in March but not as effective off 6lb higher since, on that track and over this C&D; needs extra; first-time cheekpieces replace blinkers.

runners_data.name: Clearpoint
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with excellent 5f strike-rate, ideal for controlling pace from the front
runners_data.comment: In fine form this spring, runner-up at Southwell latest; enters calculations back on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Superb run of AW form at 5f in the autumn, winning three in a row, two from the front; has remained in form since but he couldn't sustain his effort back on turf at Goodwood last time and needs to show he can reproduce his sand form on grass.

runners_data.name: Regal Envoy
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with strong course record, can lead or track leader under Murphy's guidance
runners_data.comment: 13-time winner who made all at Bath latest and is 2-2 over C&D; key player
runners_data.spotlight: Useful strike-rate and 4-6 over 5f for Oisin Murphy; can lead; versatile regarding tracks but he won his first two C&D starts (including this race when 3lb higher) and gave the principals too much rope back here in May, albeit he still found only an improved one too good; best form on good or quicker ground and rarely asked to tackle slower surfaces.

runners_data.name: Rocking Ends
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with good Windsor form but needs pace to develop over minimum distance
runners_data.comment: 0-4 in Bahrain this winter but now 1lb lower than for last year's C&D success; has claims
runners_data.spotlight: Acts well on this track and he made it 2-3 over C&D (both on good to firm) last August; had a spell in Bahrain over the winter but although he might well come on for his first run back in Britain, at Yarmouth last month, he would have more to prove if the ground is slower than good.

runners_data.name: Marching Mac
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who improves on slower ground, 3lb wrong but suits conditions
runners_data.comment: Not in peak form on AW this year but last autumn's wins make him of firm interest
runners_data.spotlight: Multiple wins at sprint trips; they were all in lower grades than today but he's not badly treated, even from 3lb wrong, and the slower the ground the better his chance against some who prefer good ground.

runners_data.name: Trefor
runners_data.note: Mid-division runner better over 6f, lacks natural speed for 5f but Hills stable in form
runners_data.spotlight: Nearly all wins over 6f, including two on this course, but speed wasn't in short supply when he won over about 5f at York (good to firm) last August; has had a marked preference for good or quicker ground up to now, though, so further rain would spell danger.

runners_data.name: Society Kiss
runners_data.note: Hold-up 3yo with natural ability, first run for new trainer after 41-day break
runners_data.comment: 1-2 for Raph Beckett as a 2yo; market informative on stable debut after 314 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Winning 5f debut (good to firm; equalled track record) for Ralph Beckett then mid-division in Group 2 Queen Mary at Royal Ascot; first run since when a never-nearer close third in a Southwell AW novice, not getting the best of runs, to one who ran well in the 3yo Dash at Epsom last week; sire and dam both handled ground slower than good; has potential on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Roach Power
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with five wins in 2025, ideal ground conditions but recent form tailing off
runners_data.comment: Hindered by wide draw last time, otherwise has a good record over 5f
runners_data.spotlight: Five wins in 2025 (all at 5f; on good, heavy and soft ground); had trip and draw excuses for first two runs this year but he'd shot his bolt over a furlong out at Goodwood last time out; might do better back on a more conventional track and the change in the weather brings him into it.

runners_data.name: Bassenthwaite
runners_data.note: Prominent 3yo returning from 143-day break, unexposed at trip but long absence concern
runners_data.comment: Bolted up on AW debut in November but not missed with an 11lb rise; first run at 6f
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed 3yo who dropped out over the new 6f trip on Newcastle AW when last seen in January; had won two of his five 5f starts previously, producing a major career best when a wide-margin winner on Wolverhampton AW last November (made all), but a sole run on soft met with failure; another with a surface query.

races.paceDynamic: Clearpoint will lead from the gates with Regal Envoy, Bassenthwaite and Roach Power tracking close behind in a moderate pace setup. The prominent group of four will dictate terms through the early stages without genuine pressure from deep closers. Over this short 5f trip on soft ground, those able to travel prominently and kick from the 2f pole will have a significant tactical edge. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and pace-pressers who can position handy rather than hold-up horses who need the race to develop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays controlled through halfway with no early burn-up
scenarios.body: The front group maintains momentum while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on testing ground over the minimum trip. Clearpoint and Regal Envoy benefit from their forward positions with Bassenthwaite swooping late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Clearpoint goes too hard early and the prominent group fractures
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainable allowing mid-division horses to pick up the pieces in the final furlong. Trefor and Society Kiss can time their runs perfectly from off the speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Speed Battle Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners engage in a pace duel from the start
scenarios.body: The early speed merchants tie up badly in the soft conditions creating opportunities for patient tactics. Hold-up specialists Gaeli and Rocking Ends can capitalize on the collapse ahead.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Clearpoint gets uncontested lead and controls fractions perfectly
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate ideal splits and kick clear approaching the final furlong. No challenger can reel in the controlled front-running performance on the testing surface.

watchPoints.text: Clearpoint must be monitored for early fractions as uncontested lead could prove decisive
Bassenthwaite returning from 143-day layoff may need run despite previous 5f form
Society Kiss switching trainers after 41-day break, market support would indicate readiness
Trefor dropping back to 5f from 6f specialist trips, may lack natural gate speed
Gaeli adapting to British tactics after Italian racing, positioning will be crucial early

races.name: Heat Your Home With Alpha Classified Stakes

runners_data.name: Arenas Del Tiempo
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer struggling on anything softer than good going with questionable recent turf form
runners_data.spotlight: Took an AW race last August but no turf win since 2021; questionable record on softer than good and she does not look the percentage call.

runners_data.name: Dubai Harbour
runners_data.note: Prominent runner better on AW but showed some turf ability last time at Lingfield
runners_data.comment: Both wins have been here on the AW over 1m2f; well beaten last time and turf is a concern
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins on Lingfield AW over 1m2f; fifth of 13 last time in a 7.6f handicap at Lingfield (good) was the best he's managed in four attempts on turf and he needs further than that, but there's a question mark about this trip.

runners_data.name: Lawn Ranger
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner with excellent Windsor record, though win drought extends back to August 2023
runners_data.comment: Veteran who has not won since August 2023 and he's struggled in both runs this year
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran who is often a zestful front-runner; no win since August 2023 but 5-15 at Windsor overall and, surprisingly, his last race here was that latest win; close second on Kempton AW (1m4f) on recent reappearance also returns him to calculations and he's won on a wide variety of ground.

runners_data.name: Gearing's Point
runners_data.note: Prominent type who found form again with recent second at this course and distance
runners_data.comment: All 4 wins in 2023, including over C&D; good 2nd to Moon Over The Sea back on turf latest
runners_data.spotlight: All four wins at about this trip in 2023; does not look the force of old (missed most of last year) but her second in C&D handicap on penultimate start gives her a shot; not proven on softer than good.

runners_data.name: Qaaeadd
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer still seeking maiden win but has shown glimpses of ability on firmer surfaces
runners_data.comment: Posted one of his better efforts last time and this new trip is worth exploring
runners_data.spotlight: Nine-race maiden with the odd piece of modest form (good to firm and AW, including 9.4f) which gives him a chance.

runners_data.name: Nymphaea
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up runner who has found her level since cheekpieces applied, each-way claims
runners_data.comment: Maiden who's found her level since cheekpieces went on; claims if her stamina holds
runners_data.spotlight: 12-race maiden who's found her level since cheekpieces went on, mostly on AW but she wasn't far away in a 1m4f Beverley handicap on good to soft either; each-way player.

runners_data.name: Guinness Lad
runners_data.note: Strong finisher who broke maiden here seven days ago from rear, unexposed on this going
runners_data.comment: 0-18 but does possess ability; usually takes a good grip and still has stamina to prove
runners_data.spotlight: 0-18 before he won a C&D handicap (good to firm) last Monday, coming from the rear; well beaten in his hurdle races on softer than good but has not encountered it on Flat and having some recent form is respected.

runners_data.name: Nala The Lioness
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 400-day absence with form concerns since leaving Burke yard
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up four times for Karl Burke (including in three bumpers, one on good to soft) but lost her form with that yard and, following a 400-day absence, there's been no sign of regaining it this year; had wind surgery after latest start and returns to turf for first time since her bumper days, so if she returned to form there would be clear reasons.

runners_data.name: Late Claim
runners_data.note: Patient performer whose form has declined since December Lingfield win, needs to bounce back
runners_data.comment: Made successful handicap debut at Lingfield in December but below that form recently.
runners_data.spotlight: Won handicap debut at Lingfield (1m5f, AW) in December and runner-up three times since but her form has subsided; minor honours in two bumpers last summer at start of her career have been her only races on turf.

runners_data.name: Panthere Noir
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden who showed improved form with cheekpieces last time at this course
runners_data.comment: Belied 50-1 odds when third at Windsor last week and remains unexposed over this trip
runners_data.spotlight: 14-race maiden; bettered low-key stable debut and belied 50-1 odds when third of 14 in C&D handicap (good to firm; refitted cheekpieces) 16 days ago, making most; more to prove if the ground is on softer than good but that latest run is not his only piece of significant form.

runners_data.name: Lilykoy
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning after 221-day break with limited ability and tendency to fade late
runners_data.spotlight: No worthwhile form (like stablemate Clough) as 2yo in two runs over 7f and one at 6f; there's a very different trip for this reappearance at a much lower level and there seems to be stacks of stamina on the dam's side, so she needs a second look in first-time headgear.

runners_data.name: Scammer
runners_data.note: Patient runner with no worthwhile form trying visor for first time
runners_data.comment: No worthwhile form in five starts on the AW; makes little appeal on turf debut; visor on
runners_data.spotlight: No worthwhile form in five starts over 7f-1m6f on the AW, including a classified and handicap with other headgear; visor is given a go this time.

runners_data.name: Fletcher
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer whose best effort came over shorter trip, heavy defeat last time concerning
runners_data.comment: Just a respectable fourth on seasonal/handicap debut (1m2f) but has scope to build on that
runners_data.spotlight: Fourth on seasonal/handicap debut at Yarmouth (1m2f, good) was his best result but a heavy defeat in 11.6f handicap at Lingfield (good to firm) dents any appeal.

runners_data.name: Clough
runners_data.note: Weak hold-up type from same stable as Lilykoy with no form of note
runners_data.comment: Poor form in two runs last month; step up in trip not enough to tempt
runners_data.spotlight: No worthwhile form (like stablemate Lilykoy) after a maiden and two novice races, the last of which was over 1m2f at this track; downgraded, stamina in the family and he's tongue tied and blinkered, both for the first time.

runners_data.name: Dream Of Ithaca
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who raced too freely last time but confirmed she has some ability
runners_data.comment: Out of her depth behind Shirakawa last time; would be a surprise winner
runners_data.spotlight: Raced freely and faded into fifth of 14 in C&D handicap (good to firm) last time, but that sixth start confirmed that she has a little ability.

runners_data.name: Majestic Leo
runners_data.note: Hold-up maiden who fades late and has major form deficiencies to overcome
runners_data.comment: Latest eighth here (11.5f, good to firm) was a best for this yard; still has work to do
runners_data.spotlight: 13-race maiden whose 2025 and 2026 form (including in handicaps here on last two starts) give him major work to do.

races.paceDynamic: Lawn Ranger will take them along from the front with Dream Of Ithaca and Dubai Harbour likely to sit handy, creating a moderate pace over this extended trip on testing ground. With only one confirmed front-runner in a large field, the tempo will be comfortable early before quickening from the home turn. The lack of early pace pressure means horses able to travel strongly and finish from mid-division or hold-up positions will have a clear tactical advantage. This race shape strongly favours patient hold-up performers who can unleash a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Artists Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lawn Ranger leads uncontested and the pace stays steady until the final three furlongs
scenarios.body: The comfortable gallop allows closers to conserve energy before unleashing telling finishes up the straight. Horses with proven stamina at this trip who can quicken from off the pace will have ideal conditions to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Trackers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Dubai Harbour or Dream Of Ithaca track the leader closely and kick from the home turn
scenarios.body: The patient prominent runners avoid traffic issues while staying close enough to pounce when the pace lifts. Their tactical position allows them to respond to any early move while having enough in reserve for the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Lawn Ranger gets an uncontested lead and the field fails to organize a strong enough challenge
scenarios.body: The 11-year-old veteran uses his tactical speed to build an unassailable advantage, with the soft ground helping his stamina reserves. His course record and front-running style perfectly suit this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If no horse takes up the running properly and the race becomes a crawl throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns it into a sprint finish where the best turn of foot wins regardless of trip. Three-year-olds with less racing mileage could benefit from the tactical muddle.

watchPoints.text: Lawn Ranger could steal this if no horse challenges his early lead and he gets away with soft fractions
Guinness Lad carries a 5lb penalty for his recent win but remains unexposed on this softer ground
Dream Of Ithaca and Dubai Harbour need to settle better in the early stages to maximize their finishing kicks
Several maidens including Nymphaea and Panthere Noir have shown recent improvement and could find more
The soft ground will test stamina reserves over this extended trip, particularly for the older horses

races.name: Network Airline Services Handicap

runners_data.name: Pepper Fizz
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but poor recent form and 16 days since last run make her vulnerable in this competitive field
runners_data.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who failed to progress last season and this campaign hasn't got off to the best of starts, finishing sixth of eight here over 1m and tailed off 16 days ago over 1m3f (first-time cheekpieces).

runners_data.name: Nautical Sky
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 76-day break but showed promise when upped in trip on handicap debut at Wolverhampton
runners_data.spotlight: Insufficient pace in 6f maidens but ran better upped to 8.6f on handicap debut at Wolverhampton, albeit no match for the 6l winner; may have more to offer.

runners_data.name: Sorted
runners_data.note: Hold-up style improving in handicaps with 76-day absence, needs to overcome the break having shown promise at Wolverhampton
runners_data.comment: Placed in last two handicaps over C&D; off ten weeks and drawn widest, but still a player
runners_data.spotlight: Has improved for the switch to handicaps, placed in the last two at Wolverhampton (8.6f; finished upside Nautical Sky in the latest); had a while off but needs respecting.

runners_data.name: Ballon Rouge
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who fits the race shape well and has winning form on good to soft, cheekpieces applied
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten a long way in both her handicaps, on the AW at 1m4f and 1m2f; on the plus side, her best maiden run was on good to soft and cheekpieces have made a big difference to her stablemate Zoustar Dreams.

runners_data.name: My Old Mate
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse but has fading tendency in finish which could be costly on testing ground
runners_data.comment: May take a step forward with Lingfield reappearance under his belt
runners_data.spotlight: Only eighth behind Buckland Belle over C&D (good to firm) two weeks ago but was only about 4l off the winner and that represented some improvement.

runners_data.name: Buckland Belle
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but won over course and distance two weeks ago on turf debut, only raised 3lb for that success
runners_data.comment: Chance depends on the effects of the switch to turf
runners_data.spotlight: 0-7 on the AW and it was her turf debut when edging home over C&D two weeks ago, keeping on to spring 25-1 surprise; only raised 3lb and the third won on Saturday, so definite chance if handling this different surface; Oisin Murphy takes over.

runners_data.name: Diamond Ali
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the pace scenario and has shown best form on good to soft ground, cheekpieces applied
runners_data.spotlight: Last three handicap runs nothing to crow about but what offers hope is that his two respectable shows in Leicester handicaps (6f-7f) were on good to soft and soft; should stay this far on breeding so not dismissed.

runners_data.name: Starakova
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fading tendency but last-time-out winner stepping up in trip for the first time
runners_data.comment: 0-7; ran quite on well on seasonal debut at Chelmsford but well held on turf since
runners_data.spotlight: Unraced beyond 7f over which she finished well off a strong pace to get off the mark at Wolverhampton; raised 6lb but she's a last-time-out winner taking on a lot of horses with much to prove.

runners_data.name: Curtain Caller
runners_data.note: Uncertain running style with minor form, cheekpieces applied but low mark doesn't look generous
runners_data.comment: Has beaten one rival in 7f novices at Southwell and Lingfield this spring
runners_data.spotlight: Minor form in her qualifying races (7f-1m) and not even this low a mark looks that generous; perhaps cheekpieces can spark something.

runners_data.name: Heated Moment
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse switching yards to Conrad Allen and now fitted with blinkers for first time
runners_data.spotlight: 0-5 for Ollie Sangster and it's been a quiet start for this yard in 1m2f handicaps; now blinkered.

runners_data.name: Blue Jammin
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with fading tendency but won on soft ground at Chepstow, blinkered and better suited to testing conditions
runners_data.comment: Found a weak soft-ground Chepstow nursery latterly; returns from nine months off
runners_data.spotlight: Won a weak soft-ground Chepstow 1m nursery in September off 3lb lower; the ground was fast when down the field here 16 days ago and he's of greater interest under these conditions.

runners_data.name: Summer Oasis
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with fading tendency and poor recent form makes her hard to fancy despite soft ground experience
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to offer much in her three outings last autumn and same again on April's handicap debut (7f AW; 100-1).

runners_data.name: Back To Black
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with fading tendency and heavy defeats suggest this mark is still too high despite stable switch
runners_data.spotlight: Heavy defeats in these colours for William Haggas (over 5f-6f) and was beaten 22l on stable/handicap debut upped to 7f at Lingfield (good; 28-1); hard to warm up.

runners_data.name: King's Courtier
runners_data.note: Leading style perfectly suits the pace scenario, blinkered for first time after disappointing handicap debut
runners_data.comment: Better in AW maiden (9.4f) three weeks ago; needs to build on that on this handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten five times, easily the best run when fourth of eight in an AW maiden (9.4f); finished tailed off on handicap debut latest (1m2f) and blinkers are now turned to.

races.paceDynamic: King's Courtier is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms without pressure in the early stages, setting a manageable gallop on the soft ground. With most of the field carrying hold-up styles, there's minimal pace pressure which means the race will likely develop into a sprint from the 2-3f pole as the hold-up horses try to close down King's Courtier's advantage. The sustained pace followed by a late burst strongly favours horses with tactical speed who can position prominently and kick, while pure hold-up horses may find themselves with too much ground to make up. This race shape clearly benefits prominent racers and those hold-up horses with proven finishing speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If King's Courtier maintains a soft pace and finds another gear when challenged
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the front runner to conserve energy before finding extra when the field closes, making it difficult for hold-up horses to peg back the advantage. Horses like Ballon Rouge and Diamond Ali who can track the pace are best placed to capitalize if the leader falters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground and sustained pace sets up perfectly for a strong finishing kick
scenarios.body: Buckland Belle and Blue Jammin can use their proven soft ground form to mount late challenges, with the testing conditions stretching the field and creating opportunities for horses coming from off the pace. The winner emerges from the pack in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Ballon Rouge or Diamond Ali use their prominent styles to track King's Courtier before pouncing
scenarios.body: The tactical positioning of the prominent runners allows them to monitor the pace and time their challenges perfectly, avoiding the traffic problems that could hinder the hold-up brigade. These horses get first run on the leader and maintain their advantage to the line.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If King's Courtier fades dramatically or pulls up, leaving no pace in the race
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint where any horse with tactical speed can capitalize on the lack of early pace. Starakova's finishing kick or Sorted's recent form could prove decisive in a slowly-run affair that turns into a dash.

watchPoints.text: King's Courtier could dominate if allowed an uncontested lead on ground that will test stamina reserves in the closing stages
Blue Jammin and Buckland Belle both have soft ground form that could be underestimated by the market given recent poor efforts on faster surfaces
Ballon Rouge and Diamond Ali are the two prominent runners best positioned to track King's Courtier and benefit from the likely pace scenario
Several hold-up horses including My Old Mate, Starakova and Blue Jammin have shown fading tendencies that could be exposed over this trip
The 76-day breaks for both Nautical Sky and Sorted need monitoring as both showed promise on their most recent handicap starts
